links.outcome: Expert review of model protocol errors to judge whether they were correct or reasonable alternatives
links.effect: Expert review found 81.9% of errors were correct or reasonable alternative protocols, raising real-world accuracy from 88.5% to 97.9%.
links.quote: Subsequent expert review of the errors performed to satisfy departmental leadership showed 81.9% were in fact correct or reasonable alternative protocols, yielding real-world performance accuracy of 97.9%.

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a BERT-based NLP model to predict MRI imaging protocols from order metadata. It includes expert radiologist review of errors but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or deployment practice.
